evidence.reason: claim_run_dir creates the record base and run directory with mkdir but never fsyncs the record-base directory entry; line 612 only creates the run dir. The recovery receipt is meant to survive a drain/switch and preserve prior SHA/trigger state, but syncing the receipt and run dir cannot make the parent entry durable. A power loss can drop the whole run dir while the host is held. Add fsync of the record base, and its parent if created, before claiming admission.
